about: Vetted public datasets products can read at GET {GATEWAY_URL}/datasets/<id>/<file> (docs/CAPABILITIES.md, section 10). Every file has its size and sha256, a license that allows redistribution, and a pinned download. scripts/caps/mirror-datasets.ts checks each one and, with --apply, copies it to Blob at datasets/<id>/<file> and fills in mirror. MNIST and Fashion-MNIST join once their sha256s and licenses are verified.

datasets.title: Palmer penguins
datasets.why: Body measurements of 344 penguins of three species on three islands near Palmer Station, Antarctica, 2007 to 2009. One row per penguin: species, island, bill length and depth, flipper length, body mass, sex and year. Good for charts, sorting, filters and simple predictions.
datasets.attribution: Palmer penguins data by Dr. Kristen Gorman and Palmer Station LTER, from the palmerpenguins package by Allison Horst, Alison Hill and Kristen Gorman (CC0)
